papers.title: Personalized HLA-aware TCR measure predicts the risk of symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection following booster vaccination
papers.summary:
-  We classified 49 files: 11 data, 19 code, 1 documentation, 18 materials.
-  We found 11 tabular data files and extracted 262 columns from 11 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex25), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 262 columns; 5 columns have at least one potential issue (4 columns with numeric values stored as text; 4 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long). We detected demographic columns for Age, Gender.
